model_annotation: The plot illustrates the loss values of different models over a range of iterations. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 140,000 with tick labels at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", also has a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Five distinct lines are plotted: "Vanilla" in purple with a solid line style, "StrmLLM (n=64)" in blue with a solid line style, "SepLLM (n=64)" in orange with a solid line style, "SepLLM (n=64, H)" in green with a solid line style, and "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" in red with a solid line style, as well as "SepLLM (n=128)" in dark purple with a solid line style. All lines start at a loss value around 3.4 and decrease as the iteration count increases. The "Vanilla" line starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at around 2.5. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" line begins at about 3.4 and ends at roughly 2.65. The "SepLLM (n=64)" line starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at around 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" line begins at about 3.3 and ends at roughly 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" line starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at around 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=128)" line begins at about 3.3 and ends at roughly 2.5. All lines exhibit a sharp decline initially, followed by a gradual decrease as the iteration count approaches 140,000.
